key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance for Q2 and first half of 2026: revenue, profit before tax, net profit/loss with YoY comparisons and key drivers of net loss
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue Q2 2026: EUR 4,503 thousand (Q2 2025: EUR 7,388 thousand); profit before tax: EUR -234 thousand (Q2 2025: EUR 1,002 thousand). H1 2026: revenue EUR 11,439 thousand (H1 2025: EUR 9,319 thousand); profit before tax EUR 186 thousand (H1 2025: EUR 296 thousand). Net loss Q2: EUR 618 thousand, H1: EUR 198 thousand, driven by EUR 384 thousand dividend tax and ~EUR 90 thousand IPO costs.

key_information_units.information: Sales contracts signed and demand indicators: number of contracts in Q2 and 6 months with YoY growth, weekly sales ratio and market share
key_information_units.source_evidence: Signed 57 sales contracts in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: 31; including 3 in Berlin) and 111 in six months (6 months 2025: 56). Weekly sales ratio reached nearly 3.1% four-week average; market share over 8% in Greater Tallinn per Citify.eu.

key_information_units.source_evidence: Handed over 12 homes in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: 35); total of 26 homes and commercial units in six months (6 months 2025: 41). No new completions in Q2.

key_information_units.information: Dividend payment and related income tax expense
key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividends of EUR 1,362 thousand paid in accordance with policy (25% of 2025 profit before tax); income tax expense on dividends EUR 384 thousand in Q2.
